description: This file defines the CursorStatement class, which extends AbstractCursorHandler to manage database cursor operations, including executing queries, handling result sets, and transaction management within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CursorStatement
classes.description: A class that manages database cursor operations, including executing queries, handling result sets, and transaction control, extending AbstractCursorHandler.

methods.name: CursorStatement
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cursor, begins a transaction, and disables auto-commit.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Handles method calls dynamically for cursor operations such as close, executeQuery, getMoreResults, getResultSet, and cursor configuration.

methods.name: newCursorStatement
methods.description: Creates a new Statement with cursor handling capabilities.

methods.name: newCursorPreparedStatement
methods.description: Creates a new PreparedStatement with cursor handling capabilities.
